coverage: approval endpoint and stale version rejection
approved /chat preserves the workflow RAG contract

interpretation: The increment proves that the three built-in multimodal business flows have explicit versioned contracts and that execution is gated by a project-scoped human review record. It does not prove end-to-end task quality, answer accuracy, or multimodal benchmark improvement.
limitations: Only the three built-in Playbooks are declared; user-authored Playbook editing and version migration are not implemented.
Generated artifact source-version IDs, generation plan, confirmation record, and change summary are not yet linked automatically to every workflow result.
The gate is a local project catalog policy; real cross-application episodes and the 30-episode competition evaluation remain incomplete.
No sealed-test data, RAG metric definition, model, or external side effect was changed.
